paragraphs.text: AI-powered Werewolf game plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
An AI-powered Werewolf game for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. Watch a complete AI game or join one se

- 6, 9, and 12-seat games.
- AI-only spectator mode and single-human participation mode.
- Werewolf,

Seer, Witch, Villager, Guard, and Hunter roles.
- Sheriff election, badge transfer, speeches, votin

g, tie-break rounds, and night actions.
- Uses the model currently selected in DeepSeek Harness.
After the first npm release, install the prebuilt package into the Web profile, then restart DSH Web
fter the first npm release, install the prebuilt package into the Web profile, then restart DSH Web:
The Host entry is maintained in `src/index.js` and copied to `lib/index.js` during the build. TypeSc
ript domain modules compile into `lib/`, and `src/client/index.js` is bundled into the browser entry
The game is process-local and currently supports one active game per DSH Web process. Its RPC channe
l is loopback-only. Restarting the DSH process discards the active game.
